statements.proposition: This change creates a new opset 24 definition of Elu with corrected documentation while keeping the original (opset 22 and earlier) Elu definitions.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: The schema macro for Elu at version 24 with 'Input tensor'/'Output tensor' exists in defs.cc, and the unchanged Elu 22 definition (with the 1D wording) was moved to old.cc; versions 1 and 6 were not touched. Caveat: Elu 24 is not declared/registered in operator_sets.h (not modified by this PR), so the new definition may not be active at runtime; the statement says only 'created a definition', so judged TRUE.
evidence: gh api pulls/7128/files: onnx/defs/math/defs.cc (modified, +5/-5), onnx/defs/math/old.cc (modified, +35/-0); no other files

statements.proposition: Moving Elu 22 to old.cc and adding a corrected Elu 24 keeps existing opsets backward compatible while introducing the corrected documentation in the latest opset.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Backward-compat half looks supported (old definitions preserved verbatim, registration of 1/6/22 unchanged), but the 'introducing the corrected documentation in the latest opset' half is doubtful because Elu 24 is not registered in operator_sets.h. I did not build ONNX to confirm the runtime effect, so not labelled TRUE or FALSE.
